researchMethod: DNS resolution + HTTP HEAD/GET checks performed on 2026-10-18. Supplemented with community knowledge of service history.

vidsrc-to.notes: DNS resolves (Cloudflare CDN). HTTP 200 confirmed. One of the most popular and stable embed providers, widely referenced in developer communities. Embed: https://vidsrc.to/embed/movie/{tmdbId}

vidsrc-io.notes: DNS resolves (Cloudflare CDN). HTTP 200 confirmed. Active mirror/variant of vidsrc network. Embed: https://vidsrc.io/embed/movie?tmdb={tmdbId}

vidsrc-mov.notes: DNS resolves (Cloudflare CDN). HTTP 200 confirmed. .mov TLD variant of the vidsrc network, actively maintained. Embed: https://vidsrc.mov/embed/movie/{tmdbId}

vidsrc-buzz.notes: DNS resolves (IP 31.58.210.185). Returns HTTP 403 on HEAD requests (typical Cloudflare bot-protection behaviour). Domain is live; browsers should work fine. Embed: https://vidsrc.buzz/embed/movie/{tmdbId}

vidsrc-xyz.notes: NXDOMAIN — domain does not resolve. Likely shut down or expired. Not recommended.

superembed.notes: multiembed.mov — DNS resolves (Cloudflare CDN). HTTP 200 confirmed. SuperEmbed is one of the more feature-rich multi-source providers. Embed: https://multiembed.mov/directstream.php?video_id={tmdbId}&tmdb=1

2embed-cc.notes: DNS resolves (IP 45.88.138.40). HTTP 200 confirmed (redirects to www.2embed.cc). Stable and widely used. Embed: https://www.2embed.cc/embed/{tmdbId}

2embed-stream.notes: DNS resolves (Cloudflare CDN). HTTP 200 confirmed. Active stream variant of 2embed. Embed: https://2embed.stream/embed/movie/{tmdbId}

embed-su.notes: NXDOMAIN — domain does not resolve at all. embed.su appears to have shut down. Not recommended.

autoembed-co.notes: DNS resolves (Cloudflare CDN). HTTP 200 confirmed. Actively maintained auto-embed service. Embed: https://autoembed.co/movie/tmdb/{tmdbId}

autoembed-app.notes: DNS resolves (Cloudflare CDN) but curl returns HTTP 000 (SSL/TLS handshake failure or connection reset). May have certificate issues or aggressive bot protection. Test in a browser before relying on it. Embed: https://player.autoembed.app/embed/movie/{tmdbId}

vidcore.notes: DNS resolves (IP 43.174.246.29). HTTP 200 confirmed. Newer provider, less community data available. Embed format likely: https://vidcore.org/embed/movie/{tmdbId}

vidspark.notes: DNS resolves (Cloudflare CDN). HTTP 200 confirmed. Relatively new provider with limited community history. Embed: https://vidspark.to/embed/movie/{tmdbId}

smashy.notes: DNS resolves (IP 209.112.89.55) but curl returns HTTP 000 (connection failure / SSL issue). May block automated requests. Check in browser. Embed: https://player.smashy.stream/movie/{tmdbId}

nontongo.notes: DNS resolves (Cloudflare CDN). HTTP 200 confirmed on www.nontongo.win. Embed: https://www.nontongo.win/embed/movie/{tmdbId}

vidsrc-sbs.notes: NXDOMAIN — domain does not resolve. vidsrc.sbs appears to be down or expired.

vidsrc-party.notes: DNS resolves (Cloudflare CDN). HTTP 200 confirmed. Part of the vidsrc network ecosystem. Embed: https://vidsrc.party/embed/movie/{tmdbId}

myflixer-api.notes: DNS resolves (Cloudflare CDN). HTTP 200 confirmed. vidsrc.myflixerapi.com is a dedicated API endpoint for movie embeds. Embed: https://vidsrc.myflixerapi.com/embed/movie/{tmdbId}

streamflizoapi.notes: DNS resolves (Cloudflare CDN). HTTP 200 confirmed. Newer API-style provider, less community history but domain and HTTP are live. Embed: https://streamflizoapi.top/embed/movie/{tmdbId}

vidsrc-me.notes: DNS resolves (Cloudflare CDN). HTTP 200 confirmed. vidsrc.me is one of the original and most referenced providers in developer communities. Stable long-term track record. Embed: https://vidsrc.me/embed/movie?tmdb={tmdbId}

streamingnow.notes: DNS resolves (Cloudflare CDN). HTTP 200 confirmed. Newer provider on .mov TLD with limited community history, but domain and HTTP checks pass. Embed: https://streamingnow.mov/embed/movie/{tmdbId}
